name: Browser read DOM
description: Reads the rendered DOM (text and/or HTML) of the visible in-app browser, stores the full content as an artifact, and returns a truncated summary plus reference.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 读取用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器已渲染的 DOM（文本或 HTML），可按 CSS 选择器限定范围；完整内容以 artifact 落盘，仅返回截断摘要与引用。
localizedDescription.en-US: Reads the rendered DOM (text and/or HTML) of the visible in-app browser, stores the full content as an artifact, and returns a truncated summary plus reference.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope the read to a subtree (first match).

format.description: Whether to read visible text or raw HTML. Defaults to text.
